inv.desc_en: COMMERCIAL PREMISES on Rambla de Catalunya/Diputació, of 989 m2. with direct and individual access from the street (gallery), distributed over two levels: Street level of 465 m2. connected to level 0 by private elevator and 2 staircases. Level 0 of 524 m2. , with a large interior patio for natural ventilation and lighting. Very open-plan surfaces (currently divided by panels), equipped with air conditioning, heating, flooring, and technical installations, adapted access, and 5 unisex bathrooms. Possible rental for €19,000/month, as well as acquisition of a basement-storage of 248 m2. for an additional €300,000. Located in a VIP commercial and office area. Multiple authorized uses (commercial, residential, offices, healthcare, recreational, sports, cultural, etc. ), currently used as offices.
